sections.heading: History
sections.text:
from Klaus]]
Zhalia Moon was an orphan living in the streets. She could barely find anything to eat and was bullied by other kids. Until she was adopted by Klaus, an evil Organization scientist, who saw something in her. Offered power and a place to belong, she was trained in espionage as an Organization agent. She was given the Amulet of Gareon, and the two quickly bonded. [The Vampire Loses Its Fangs]

As an Organization operative, she was sent as a spy to infiltrate the Huntik Foundation. Originally a rival, she became a member of Dante Vale's team alongside Lok Lambert, Sophie Casterwill, and Cherit. [Words of Truth, Heart of Lies] She did, however, sustain a bitter relationship with Sophie.

Through her time with the Foundation, she found unexpected friends in both Lok and Dante but was still loyal to Klaus, the one man whom she considered to be a father figure. Turning on her new friends in the castle of Vlad Dracul under Klaus' instructions, Zhalia found herself unable to finish off those whom she considered to be her friends. Though she joined Dante instead of attacking him, Dante was still defeated by Klaus. In a last-ditch effort, Zhalia invoked King Basilisk, using its power to turn Klaus into stone. After the battle, Zhalia decided to leave the team, ashamed of what she had done. [The Vampire Loses Its Fangs]

Zhalia continued to feel guilty over her betrayal and decided to help them claim the Legendary Titan of Body, Behemoth, After posing as an Amazon who wanted leadership of the tribe, she gained possession of the Amulet and gave it to Dante. This marked her rejoining the Huntik team. [Ladies' Choice]

When captured by the Professor, himself, Zhalia claimed herself to be Vensetta Qew, an operative for the Organization. [To Be Together]

During the mission to the Professor's castle, Zhalia remained with an emotionally scarred Dante as the others went after the Professor. When the two found themselves under attack by Undergolem Titans invoked by Eathon the dog, Zhalia's Titans were each swiftly defeated. After Dante came to his senses and defeated the Undergolem Titans, the two joined the fight against the Professor and his Legendary Titans, eventually defeating him. [The Mission]

Zhalia was left deeply troubled after being shown her future as a member of the Blood Spiral in a dreamworld created by Arc, the Legendary Titan of Fate. [The Legendary Titan of Fate] After her plan to stop Kiel, a Blood Spiral hunter failed, Zhalia realised that to beat the Spiral, she had to play to her strengths and become a spy and fight them from the inside. She left the Huntik team and said a tearful goodbye to Dante, giving him the Logosbook to keep in contact. [Zhalia's Mission]

After impressing Tantras with her loyalty, she was assigned as a personal bodyguard to Harrison Fears. [Boys Will Be Seekers] Over time, she grew attached to Harrison not only due to her mission, but also because of her liking towards him, becoming an older sister figure to him. [Lok and the Betrayer]

While undercover, she used a special diary to keep in contact with Dante through the Logosbook spell. When she wrote in her diary, the message was transmitted to Dante's copy of the diary, thus updating the team and the Huntik Foundation about the Blood Spiral's plans. When Tantras took her Logosbook, he noticed that she reported to Dante and commented that she must care for him very much. [Sophie on Trial]

When the Betrayer revealed Dante's apparent death, she became devastated, dropping her disguise and openly revealing her alliance to the Foundation. [Lok and the Betrayer] Although she had previously received a message from Dante saying that they wouldn't be rid of him so easily, she was still shocked when he came back to life by using Copykind on Phoenix's Rebirth ability. After the Betrayer was finally defeated, she returned to the Huntik team, now led by Lok, with Dante having now joined the Huntik Foundation Council. [Dante's Return]

sections.heading: Personality
sections.text:
Despite being an expert at infiltration and spying, Zhalia sometimes has trouble masking her anxiety, as evidenced several times leading up to her exposure by Klaus and her subsequent redemption. [The Vampire Loses Its Fangs] She does not like being pushed around and will do things the way she wants most of the time. Zhalia tries to act strong and tough, but within she was weak until Dante showed her the way. [The Mission]

Zhalia's crush on team-member Dante Vale began during the mission to recover King Basilisk, who would become one of Zhalia's principle Titans. [Absent Heroes] Dante was the first person in her life she felt expressed trust in her, choosing her to deliver the Hoplite Amulets recovered from the sunken Argo. [Like Father, Unlike Son] Due to this trust, Dante meant more to her that anything else in the world. [The Divine Comedy]

Zhalia also has a strong connection to the Fears brothers, especially Harrison. The two brothers come from the orphanage Zhalia lived in before the Organization, and their situation with the Blood Spiral is very similar to her experience with the Organization. During Zhalia's undercover mission, she was Harrison's bodyguard. This gave her access to information known only to higher-ups and a special relationship with Harrison. Harrison once said that she "was like a sister," suggesting that her bond with him wasn't just out of duty to her mission. Zhalia also had a rivalry with Sophie until the Professor's defeat, where Lok noted they're getting along better. [S2E27]

Abilities
sections.wikitext:
[[File:S1E08 Zhalia Gareon.jpg|thumb|200px|Zhalia fights with [[Gareon]] at her side.]]
Many of Zhalia's choice spells revolve around infiltration and [[:Category:Mental spells|illusory]] magic, using spells to make her become more agile and to confuse her enemies. When such tactics fail, she is prepared to use every ounce of her fighting power in battle.

Due to her having acted as an agent for [[the Organization]], she learned their spells in addition to basic [[Huntik Foundation|Foundation]] spells. She has also learned several [[:Category:Blood Spiral magic|Blood Spiral spells]] from infiltrating the order.

In addition to her powers as a [[Seeker]], Zhalia is a master in the art of spying. She's got various equipment to infiltrate or exfiltrate places, and is skilled enough with computers to retrieve data {{Source|Doorway to Huntik}}. With her magic, disguise kits, and ability to perfectly emulate different accents including French and Italian, Zhalia is able to almost perfectly conceal her identity. {{Source|Into the River of Secrets}} She also has vast amounts of knowledge concerning [[Amazons|Amazon]] history and culture which she used to gain the title of "Amazon Queen" from [[Hippolyta]]. {{source|Ladies' Choice}}

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
*Zhalia is 25 years old, according to the ''[[Huntik Magazine]]'' [[Grand Dragon Leviathan (Comic)|Issue 9]] ''Seeker Community'' section which answers questions sent in by readers.
*In the first season's trailer, Zhalia and Dante's hair colors were switched, with Zhalia's being brown.
*The show's artistic director, [[Simone Borselli]], revealed in an interview with ''Vanity Fair'' that Zhalia's appearance was inspired by that of the American movie actress [[:wikipedia:Demi Moore|Demi Moore]].
*Zhalia's name meaning and origin, due to the unusual spelling, cause some speculation. It might come from either the Australian ''Zahlia'', invented after a famous climber, or Zalia, a variant of Zelia, meaning '''solemn''' in French or '''zeal, envy''' in Greek.
*The background supervisor for the show, Tommaso Gomez, considered Zhalia the best character. {{Extsource|1=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AjYWmvnOqQo&list=PL6NZlSvyFyQU-o6alH6pXfEqPNXEBFSQo|2=YouTube}}

== Relationships ==
===Dante Vale===
]]
Zhalia and Dante had heard of one another as Foundation Seekers, and had a lot of respect for each other's skills, with Dante inviting her to help the Huntik team in Prague after their first meeting. [S1E03] While other members of his team, particularly Sophie Casterwill, took a distrust to Zhalia, Dante saw her as reliable and trustworthy, and let her prove herself to the team by rescuing Peter in Rouen. [S1E04] Dante assured Zhalia that he trusted her after asking her to deliver DeFoe's Amulets which meant a great deal to her as nobody had ever told her that. [S1E10] Over time, the pair began to develop feelings for one another [S1E17], and despite Zhalia's betrayal of his team to Klaus, Dante understood her reasons and forgave her. [S1E17] After the explosion at her apartment, the pair almost kissed but were interrupted by Lok Lambert. [The Unseen Guide] They grew deeply protective of one another [S1E23] [S2E27] and Zhalia later admitted that Dante meant more to her than anything else in the world. [S1E25] 

When Zhalia chose to leave the team to infiltrate the Blood Spiral, Dante was deeply saddened but understood why she had to go. [S2E35] They stayed in touch by writing in a pair of Logosbook journals [S2E36] from which even Tantras could tell Zhalia cared for him a great deal. [S2E39] When Zhalia discovered Dante had sacrificed himself to stop the Red Comet, she was devastated. [S2E51] However, Dante had written her a final message revealing his ultimate secret plan, and Zhalia was overjoyed to see him rise from the ashes. [S2E52]

She left the Huntik team and said a tearful goodbye to Dante, giving him the [[Logosbook]] to keep in contact. {{source|Zhalia's Mission}} After impressing [[Tantras]] with her loyalty, she was assigned as a personal bodyguard to [[Harrison Fears]]. {{source|Boys Will Be Seekers}} Over time, she grew attached to Harrison not only due to her mission, but also because of her liking towards him, becoming an older sister figure to him. {{source|Lok and the Betrayer}} While undercover, she used a special diary to keep in contact with Dante through the [[Logosbook]] spell. When she wrote in her diary, the message was transmitted to Dante's copy of the diary, thus updating the team and the Huntik Foundation about the Blood Spiral's plans. When Tantras took her Logosbook, he noticed that she reported to Dante and commented that she must care for him very much. {{Source|Sophie on Trial}} [[File:S2E51 Zhalia cry.png|thumb|170px|Zhalia breaks down after Dante's death]] When [[the Betrayer]] revealed Dante's apparent death, she became devastated, dropping her disguise and openly revealing her alliance to the Foundation. {{source|Lok and the Betrayer}} Although she had previously received a message from Dante saying that they wouldn't be rid of him so easily, she was still shocked when he came back to life by using [[Copykind]] on [[Phoenix|Phoenix's]] Rebirth ability. After the Betrayer was finally defeated, she returned to the Huntik team, now led by Lok, with Dante having now joined the [[Huntik Foundation Council]]. {{source|Dante's Return}} ==Personality == [[File:S1E24 Zhalia.png|thumb|200px]] Despite being an expert at infiltration and spying, Zhalia sometimes has trouble masking her anxiety, as evidenced several times leading up to her exposure by [[Klaus]] and her subsequent redemption. {{source|The Vampire Loses Its Fangs}} She does not like being pushed around and will do things the way she wants most of the time. Zhalia tries to act strong and tough, but within she was weak until Dante showed her the way. {{source|The Mission}} Zhalia's crush on team-member [[Dante Vale]] began during the mission to recover [[King Basilisk]], who would become one of Zhalia's principle Titans. {{source|Absent Heroes}} Dante was the first person in her life she felt expressed trust in her, choosing her to deliver the [[Hoplite]] Amulets recovered from the sunken [[Argo]]. {{source|Like Father, Unlike Son}} Due to this trust, Dante meant more to her that anything else in the world. {{source|The Divine Comedy}} Zhalia also has a strong connection to the Fears brothers, especially Harrison. The two brothers come from the orphanage Zhalia lived in before the Organization, and their situation with the Blood Spiral is very similar to her experience with the Organization. During Zhalia's undercover mission, she was Harrison's bodyguard. This gave her access to information known only to higher-ups and a special relationship with Harrison. Harrison once said that she "was like a sister," suggesting that her bond with him wasn't just out of duty to her mission. Zhalia also had a rivalry with Sophie until the Professor's defeat, where Lok noted they're getting along better. {{source|S2E27}} == Relationships == ===[[Dante Vale]]=== [[File:S2E52 Zhalia Dante.png|190px|thumb|Zhalia and Dante finally reunited after the war with [[the Betrayer]]]] Zhalia and Dante had heard of one another as Foundation Seekers, and had a lot of respect for each other's skills, with Dante inviting her to help the Huntik team in Prague after their first meeting. {{Source|S1E03}} While other members of his team, particularly [[Sophie Casterwill]], took a distrust to Zhalia, Dante saw her as reliable and trustworthy, and let her prove herself to the team by rescuing [[Peter]] in Rouen. {{Source|S1E04}} Dante assured Zhalia that he trusted her after asking her to deliver [[DeFoe]]'s Amulets which meant a great deal to her as nobody had ever told her that. {{Source|S1E10}} Over time, the pair began to develop feelings for one another {{Source|S1E17}}, and despite Zhalia's betrayal of his team to [[Klaus]], Dante understood her reasons and forgave her. {{Source|S1E17}} After the explosion at her [[Zhalia Moon's apartment|apartment]], the pair almost kissed but were interrupted by [[Lok Lambert]]. {{source|The Unseen Guide}} They grew deeply protective of one another {{Source|S1E23}} {{source|S2E27}} and Zhalia later admitted that Dante meant more to her than anything else in the world. {{source|S1E25}} When Zhalia chose to leave the team to infiltrate the [[Blood Spiral]], Dante was deeply saddened but understood why she had to go. {{Source|S2E35}} They stayed in touch by writing in a pair of [[Logosbook]] journals {{source|S2E36}} from which even [[Tantras]] could tell Zhalia cared for him a great deal. {{Source|S2E39}} When Zhalia discovered Dante had sacrificed himself to stop the [[Red Comet]], she was devastated. {{Source|S2E51}} However, Dante had written her a final message revealing his ultimate secret plan, and Zhalia was overjoyed to see him rise from the ashes. {{Source|S2E52}} ==Abilities == [[File:S1E08 Zhalia Gareon.jpg|thumb|200px|Zhalia fights with [[Gareon]] at her side.]] Many of Zhalia's choice spells revolve around infiltration and [[:Category:Mental spells|illusory]] magic, using spells to make her become more agile and to confuse her enemies. When such tactics fail, she is prepared to use every ounce of her fighting power in battle. Due to her having acted as an agent for [[the Organization]], she learned their spells in addition to basic [[Huntik Foundation|Foundation]] spells. She has also learned several [[:Category:Blood Spiral magic|Blood Spiral spells]] from infiltrating the order. In addition to her powers as a [[Seeker]], Zhalia is a master in the art of spying. She's got various equipment to infiltrate or exfiltrate places, and is skilled enough with computers to retrieve data {{Source|Doorway to Huntik}}. With her magic, disguise kits, and ability to perfectly emulate different accents including French and Italian, Zhalia is able to almost perfectly conceal her identity. {{Source|Into the River of Secrets}} She also has vast amounts of knowledge concerning [[Amazons|Amazon]] history and culture which she used to gain the title of "Amazon Queen" from [[Hippolyta]]. {{source|Ladies' Choice}} ===Spells Utilized=== {{SpellCol}} * [[Armorbrand]] * [[Augerfrost]] * [[Boltflare]] * [[Breakspell]] {{TCGTitan|TCG:SAS-104}} * [[Bubblelift]] * [[Clonemask]] * [[Darkfog]] * [[Darksleep]] * [[Earthtide]] {{TCGTitan|TCG:SAS-116}} * [[Everfight]] * [[Farslip]] * [[Headcage]] * [[Hyperstride]] * [[Logosbook]] * [[Mindsight]] * [[Nullcurse]] * [[Poisonfang]] * [[Raypulse]] * [[Shadowpoint]] {{TCGTitan|TCG:LGS-066}} * [[Shadowspeed]] * [[Simplemind]] * [[Thoughtspecter]] * [[Touchram]] * [[Venomhand]] {{SpellColEnd}} ===Bonded Titans=== {{TitanCollection}} {{TitanRow|[[Gar-Ghoul]] | | | Zhalia stole its Amulet from [[DeFoe]]'s collection of unbonded Titans after Dante asked her to deliver them to a Foundation safehouse.}} {{TitanRow|[[Gareon|Gareon, Powerbonded]] | | | Zhalia's first and Signature Titan, given to her by [[Klaus]] when she was a child on the streets of [[Rotterdam]]; She often already has him invoked in secret such is the strength of their bond. }} {{TitanRow|[[Harlekin]] | | | The most common Titan issued to [[Silent Soldiers]], Zhalia acquired one when she infiltrated the [[Blood Spiral]]; [[Harrison]] told her to invoke it to attack [[Den]]. }} {{TitanRow|[[Hoplite]] | | | Recovered from a chest of Hoplites in the [[Argo]], Zhalia gave the other Amulets to the Huntik team. }} {{TitanRow|[[Januseea the Gatekeeper]] | | | Obtained sometime after the defeat of [[the Professor]] and prior to the discovery of the Nexus in Peru.}} {{TitanRow|[[Kilthane]] | | | Acquired in her youth while training with [[Ryder]] in [[the Organization]]; Kilthane is Zhalia's go-to brawler Titan. }} {{TitanRow|[[King Basilisk]] | | | Recovered from [[Basilisk House]], King Basilisk quickly became one Zhalia's most favored and distinctive Titans. }} {{TitanRow|[[Strix]] | | | Acquired in her youth as a member of [[the Organization]].}} {{TitanRow|[[Triton]] | comic | | The third Triton of Alexandria, given to her by [[Dante]] so that she bypass the magical forcefield of the Lighthouse of Alexandria.}} {{TitanRow|[[Mucalin]] |tcg| | A seven-headed serpent used by Zhalia as a protector. }} {{TitanCollectionFooter}} == Gallery == {{Gallery}} File:Zhalia Moon.png|Zhalia Moon File:Zhalia Moon Season 2.jpg|Zhalia's Season 2 Outfit File:Zhalia Moon 4.jpg|Zhalia's Stock Art File:S1E17 Zhalia young.png|Zhalia the street orphan File:S1E17 Zhalia Suit.png|Zhalia as a [[Suit]] in the [[Organization]] File:S2E36 Zhalia tattoo.png|Zhalia as a [[Silent Soldier]] in the [[Blood Spiral]] File:S1E25 Zhalia 2.png File:S2E29 Zhalia 2.png File:S2E35 Zhalia 5.png File:S2E31 Zhalia 7.png File:S2E52 Zhalia invokes Gareon.png File:S2E52 Zhalia logosbook.png File:S2E33 Zhalia.png File:S2E31 Zhalia reveal.jpg File:S1E17 Zhalia.jpg File:Zhalia Scuba.webp|Zhalia in her scuba gear ==Trivia== *Zhalia is 25 years old, according to the ''[[Huntik Magazine]]'' [[Grand Dragon Leviathan (Comic)|Issue 9]] ''Seeker Community'' section which answers questions sent in by readers. *In the first season's trailer, Zhalia and Dante's hair colors were switched, with Zhalia's being brown. *The show's artistic director, [[Simone Borselli]], revealed in an interview with ''Vanity Fair'' that Zhalia's appearance was inspired by that of the American movie actress [[:wikipedia:Demi Moore|Demi Moore]]. *Zhalia's name meaning and origin, due to the unusual spelling, cause some speculation. It might come from either the Australian ''Zahlia'', invented after a famous climber, or Zalia, a variant of Zelia, meaning '''solemn''' in French or '''zeal, envy''' in Greek. *The background supervisor for the show, Tommaso Gomez, considered Zhalia the best character. {{Extsource|1=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AjYWmvnOqQo&list=PL6NZlSvyFyQU-o6alH6pXfEqPNXEBFSQo|2=YouTube}} [[Category:Characters]] [[Category:Seekers]] [[Category:Huntik Foundation members]] [[Category:Organization members]] [[Category:Blood Spiral members]] [[Category:Blooded Circle]] [[Category:Suits]]
